_help: Links for grant titles, used by scripts/build_data.py. 'programs' are checked first: the first entry whose 'match' text appears in the grant's funder line wins (case-insensitive). Other NIH awards link to their NIH RePORTER project page, looked up at build time. 'manual' maps an exact grant title to a URL and overrides both. URLs were checked to open (HTTP 200) on 2026-10-30.
